svg.aria-label: Data flow: Claude Code, Copilot, Codex, and custom agents send telemetry and model traffic into your network, where the LLM gateway proxies model traffic upstream. Telemetry, the gateway callback, and source-control git history and CI/CD outcomes land as facts in PostgreSQL, are derived into labeled completions and rollouts, and are projected as DPO, SFT, recovery, and RLVR exports feeding your training frameworks, RL environments, or managed fine-tuning platform.
